provenance: Reconstructed task contract on frozen real source artifacts, not the original historical prompt.

criteria.pass: Reject coordinate-only as a generally sufficient replacement; a wrong hard-argmax window receives only local direct coordinate gradients, not direct per-logit supervision of a distant correct peak. Do not claim shared parameters can never alter outside logits.
Give a counterexample with GT outside the selected window and >32 px from X0; sigmoid refinement is confined to its 64px patch.
Retain or replace dense spatial/proposal supervision with an explicit signal that can reward the distant GT and penalize wrong alternatives, and mask ignored/invalid/reference supervision correctly.
Propose proposal recall/capture-range and held-out localization checks; distinguish structural reasoning from measured model performance; avoid mandatory wire geometry.

promotion_scope: Only the supplied bounded task; no broad model-equivalence claim.
